name: QuestDB
overview: Phenomenal for hardware telemetry due to its low-latency ingestion. SQL syntax makes it easy for LLMs to query without learning PromQL or Flux.
details: QuestDB is built from the ground up for maximum ingestion throughput, often used in high-frequency trading and low-latency IoT networks.

Its primary advantage for an OpenClaw swarm is that it speaks native SQL. If an agent (like `sre_telemetry`) needs to query historical power constraints, writing SQL is significantly less prone to LLM hallucination than writing complex PromQL queries.
